purpose_zh: 先修正融合执行与信息接口，再验证是否存在有证据支持的干预，不以强制改变候选制造改善。
flow: Frozen Anchor and original operators generate candidates
Original online Proxy plus frozen offline Residual score the shortlist
Program computes protected candidate selection under each predefined fusion configuration
Retrieve informative same-context training cases from distinct functions
Check heldout-training context support and positive retrieved local evidence
Unsupported: original selection, no API request
Supported request epoch: LLM or matched deterministic retrieval chooses an eligible configuration
Shared original gate executes the selected configuration; preserve independent Anchor slot
True evaluation within unchanged NFE; record competing-slot feedback and semantic logs

calibration.contexts: proxy/residual best-candidate agreement crossed with remaining-budget below 0.15
calibration.support: At least 3 changed heldout cases from at least 2 functions, positive function-balanced normalized one-step advantage
calibration.runtime_support: Positive mean advantage among retrieved same-context changed cases
calibration.no_guarantee: Heuristic, one-step validation; neither statistical certification nor terminal-performance guarantee

reproducibility.historical_audit_source: R02 pre-repair exact offline replay; parent commit identifies original code
